detail: Tavily public-data fallback landed in enrich.py (on origin/main). Proven by forcing a real Iridium failure (invalid IRIDIUM_API_KEY in one process): 401 at /auth/login => ZERO live LinkedIn searches spent. 3/3 speakers resolved from public web data, full 25-pick briefing produced, judge confirmed the Tavily facts grounded. Same disambiguation discipline as the LinkedIn path (_score reused, MIN_SCORE bar, name+independent anchor required; only sentences naming the speaker become facts). Unconfirmed => no facts (verified: no-anchor speakers come back fact-less). All 3 branches degrade loudly via _degrade/take_degradations. Cache-by-policy still NOT a degradation (D-015).

TWO ONE-LINE WIRINGS NEEDED IN server.py (A6), enrich.py side is done: (1) server never calls fleet.enrich.take_degradations() -- a real forced-failure run stranded 3 degradation strings that never reached briefing.degradations; add 'degradations += import_module("fleet.enrich").take_degradations()' after the enrich steps. (2) enrich_speakers now accepts an OPTIONAL event_name kwarg (backwards compatible, existing call unaffected); passing event_name gives the public fallback a second identity anchor. Also FYI for C: in that run judge flagged facts_grounded=False on a FACT-LESS speaker (Amy Boyd) whose rank reason came from roster session_title, not enrichment -- the tavily-sourced picks were judged grounded.

Split budgets shipped (b6e56db, on origin/main). enrich_speakers(speakers, limit=3, public_limit=12, event_name=None) -- limit is the LinkedIn budget only, speakers past it skip Iridium entirely and go straight to public web data. Renderable picks 2 -> 10 on the 19-speaker World's Fair roster (12 if the caller passes event_name). LinkedIn searches issued: ZERO (only 3x /auth/login from the forced 401). Full run through prep_conference: 35.9s. Interleaved A/B vs old coverage: enrichment 2.2s -> 2.4s warm, 5.0s for 7 cold lookups in one round; rank swings 12-39s on IDENTICAL input, so run latency is Nebius variance, not coverage. Discipline held at the wider net: 60 facts across 2 real rosters, every fact names its own speaker and carries a Per <domain>: stamp, 20 of 44 speakers still correctly fact-less. limit=0 verified: 0 Iridium HTTP requests, public plane still enriched 6/7.

FOR A/C, latency: enrichment is NOT the bottleneck (2-6s). Measured phases on a 19-speaker roster: roster 18.7s, enrich 6.4s, rank 29.2s, judge 11.8s. rank() generates a reason for ALL 19 speakers, so its cost tracks roster size, not enrichment payload -- it measured 12.0s and 39.0s on identical input in the same session. If the demo needs to be faster, the two levers are roster (~19s, B) and ranking the full roster (C), not enrichment. NOTE for A: server.py still calls enrich_speakers(speakers) without event_name; passing it raises coverage 10 -> 12 at no extra cost.
